name: mirage
text: Important detail: the parlay maker is the other side of the bet. A buyer takes a parlay from us; we win when the buyer's parlay misses and lose when it hits. So '3 lost' means 3 buyers' parlays hit (about -$7 total), not that we were betting parlays. Buyers' 2-4 leg parlays hit roughly 20-35% of the time, so 3 hits in 3 settled is unlucky, not proof the pricing is wrong; the sample is far too small. What decides it is whether we price each one at or above true odds, which the data so far says we do (market pays 0.6 points over our fair). I won't change the pricing on 3 results.
